lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is regular, roughly equidistant in the mid-section and narrowing towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the fourth line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-junction at the mid-shoulder level.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 9 through 12 terminate approximately 70% down the torso height, failing to reach the ventral fringe boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 5 distinct white circular spots is positioned on the upper hind limb, superior to the large white vertical patch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align along a horizontal axis, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, emerging laterally at approximately 40 degrees from the skull base before curving inward and upward in a spiral vector.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 3.2 times the pixel width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The ivory-colored terminal tips comprise approximately 12% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three Red-billed Oxpeckers (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) positioned on the neck and mid-lateral torso areas of the primary subject.
